Lessons.Title: Geometric Sequences
ExplanationParagraphs: Geometric sequences have constant ratio r between consecutive nonzero terms.
Negative ratios alternate signs; |r|<1 causes decay toward zero.
Constant nonzero sequence is both arithmetic and geometric.
Independent Cool-down: calculate a representative source-family example and check the result with the definition.
